tools.name: simkl_get_trending_by_genre
tools.description: Get monthly trending titles for one genre from Simkl’s public CDN. Rankings are updated daily, contain up to 500 titles, and have no upstream pagination. The CDN request needs no user token and uses no Simkl daily quota or per-second rate. Supply an exact genre slug from the selected media type’s genre index; returns up to maxResults rich items without fetching details per title.

tools.name: simkl_search_by_text
tools.description: Search by text query

q.description: Required. The search term — matches `title` and `all_titles[]` across the chosen catalog (movies / TV / anime).  Examples: `john wick`, `john wick 2014`, `breaking bad`, `cowboy bebop`.

extended.description: `full` adds overview, ratings, and genres to each match.

sort.description: Result order. `relevance` (default) puts the best match first; `release-date` newest first; `last-air-date` most recently aired first — **TV and anime only**, a `400` on `movie`; `title` A–Z; `rank` m

tools.name: simkl_get_shows_by_genre
tools.description: Live TV genre browsing supports other sorts and country, network, and year filters. Under AUTH V2 it requires the user access token and consumes the user’s daily allowance; live requests also count toward the per-second limit. Pagination is capped at page 20 and 60 items per page. Prefer simkl_get_trending_by_genre for this month’s most watched titles in one genre (daily-updated CDN file, no token or upstream quota).

genre.description: TV genre slug, or `all`. See description for the full set.

year.description: `all`, single year, or decade. Bogus values silently fall back to `all`.

tools.name: simkl_get_anime_by_genre
tools.description: Live anime genre browsing supports other sorts and network and year filters. Under AUTH V2 it requires the user access token and consumes the user’s daily allowance; live requests also count toward the per-second limit. Pagination is capped at page 20 and 60 items per page. Prefer simkl_get_trending_by_genre for this month’s most watched titles in one genre (daily-updated CDN file, no token or upstream quota).

genre.description: Anime genre slug, or `all`. See description for the full set.

tools.name: simkl_get_movies_by_genre
tools.description: Live movie genre browsing supports other sorts and country and year filters. Under AUTH V2 it requires the user access token and consumes the user’s daily allowance; live requests also count toward the per-second limit. Pagination is capped at page 20 and 60 items per page. Prefer simkl_get_trending_by_genre for this month’s most watched titles in one genre (daily-updated CDN file, no token or upstream quota).

genre.description: Movie genre slug, or `all`. See description for the full set.

type.description: Reserved — always pass the literal value `movies`.

year.description: `all`, single year (`2019`), or decade (`2010s`, `2000s`). Bogus values silently fall back to `all`.

tools.name: simkl_get_user_stats
tools.description: Get watch statistics for another explicitly identified Simkl user. For your own authenticated account, use simkl_my_stats instead: it reads the per-account cache without a settings lookup.

user_id.description: Numeric Simkl ID of another explicitly identified user. For your own account, use simkl_my_stats with no arguments; do not fetch /users/settings.

tools.name: simkl_get_watchlist
tools.description: Search the authenticated user’s cached watchlist. Filters by media type, status, and title, then returns compact matching items with progress, next episode, rating, and a Simkl link.

offset.description: Zero-based number of matching results to skip; defaults to 0.

tools.name: simkl_start_rewatch
tools.description: Explicitly start or resume a Simkl rewatch session for a movie, TV show or anime already in the user history. Requires PRO/VIP. Simkl applies a two-day gap between repeat watches. The response includes the upstream rewatch_id and status; retain the ID for later updates.

tools.name: simkl_update_rewatch
tools.description: Add viewing events to a specific rewatch session. Always supply the rewatch_id returned by Simkl. TV/anime completion is determined by Simkl when all aired regular episodes are covered.

tools.name: simkl_get_rewatches
tools.description: Read compact rewatch sessions from the per-user activities-gated cache, separate from the canonical watchlist. No incremental sync parameters are accepted.

tools.name: simkl_stop_watching
tools.description: Stop watching and return the Simkl scrobble response. A 409 already_watched conflict is an already_recorded success with the original watched_at: do not retry. Set allow_rewatch=true only when the user explicitly chose to record this playback as a rewatch; it requires PRO/VIP and progress of at least 80%.

allow_rewatch.description: Explicitly record this stop as a rewatch. Defaults to false.

tools.name: simkl_refresh_library
tools.description: Request a manual Simkl library refresh, limited to once every 60 seconds per account. Normal reads use the five-minute interval; post-write checks remain mandatory.

tools.name: simkl_my_stats
tools.description: Get cached watching statistics for the current authenticated Simkl account. Use for own-account stats; no user ID or /users/settings request is needed.
